title: Power Automate: time and cost savings rules for desktop flows
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented controls are supported, and it distinguishes desktop flow plans from documentation for cloud flows and agents. Add the Dataverse update reference to support the HTTP headers printed in the API calls.

The roadmap describes built-in time and cost savings rules for desktop flows.
claims.quote: This feature introduces built-in rules that calculate time and cost savings for desktop flows based on successful runs.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A maker supplies the manual task duration and the platform computes time saved from flow run data.
claims.quote: You can define how long a task previously took when performed manually and let the platform compute time saved using flow run data.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: An hourly rate can be used to estimate money savings.
claims.quote: Cost savings can be estimated by applying hourly rates or custom monetary baselines that scale with run volume.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: A maker-defined money baseline can be used to estimate money savings.
claims.quote: To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

claims.claim: The estimated savings scale with run volume.
claims.quote: Cost savings can be estimated by applying hourly rates or custom monetary baselines that scale with run volume. Savings accumulate automatically as flows run

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Savings rules are configured for an individual desktop flow.
claims.quote: To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Savings are calculated per successful run.
claims.quote: Once configured, savings are calculated per successful run and aggregated automatically.

claims.claim: Configured savings are aggregated automatically.
claims.quote: Once configured, savings are calculated per successful run and aggregated automatically.

claims.claim: Turning off the configured rules stops savings tracking.
claims.quote: The calculations can be disabled by turning off the configured rules, allowing you to control when savings are tracked.

claims.claim: Desktop flow savings are user-opt-in: tracking starts only after a maker configures rules.
claims.quote: The feature is not enabled automatically. To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

Enabled for:

claims.claim: At the time of writing, Learn does not describe the desktop flow savings feature itself.
claims.quote: Searched: "Measure time and cost savings for desktop flows"; "desktop flows" "savings" rules license prerequisites storage retention money saving setting. Opened Savings in Power Automate, Savings on agent flows and Manage feature settings; these describe cloud flows, agent flows and agents.

claims.claim: Learn documents user-defined savings rules for cloud flows.
claims.quote: You can add a user-defined saving rule to each cloud flow, which generates savings at successful cloud flow runs.

claims.claim: Learn documents user-defined savings rules for agent flows.
claims.quote: You can add a user-defined saving rule to each flow, which keeps track of savings on successful flow runs.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence requirement specific to desktop flow savings has not been published, so its licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate licensing desktop flow savings time cost savings license meter. Opened Types of Power Automate licenses and Savings in Power Automate; read licensing FAQ results. General desktop automation licensing is documented, but no savings-specific requirement was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a price for desktop flow savings.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate licensing desktop flow savings time cost savings license meter. Opened Types of Power Automate licenses, Pay-as-you-go meters and Savings in Power Automate; no price for savings rules was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a meter specifically for desktop flow savings.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate licensing desktop flow savings time cost savings license meter. Opened Pay-as-you-go meters, Types of Power Automate licenses and Savings in Power Automate; flow-run and storage meters are documented, but no savings-rule meter was found.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: roadmap names none
claims.claim: The roadmap record names no licence, price or meter.
claims.quote: This feature introduces built-in rules that calculate time and cost savings for desktop flows based on successful runs.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance controls: final paragraph
claims.claim: Viewing and editing cloud flow saving rules requires a security role with privileges to Saving Rule and Flow Aggregation.
claims.quote: To view and edit a saving-rule, you need a security role with privileges to the Saving Rule and the Flow Aggregation tables.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: agent flows comparison
claims.claim: Viewing and editing agent flow savings rules requires a security role with privileges to Saving Rule and Flow Aggregation.
claims.quote: To view and edit a savings rule, you need a security role with privileges to the Saving Rule and the Flow Aggregation tables.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited cloud flow and agent flow savings pages name no licence or meter.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate licensing desktop flow savings time cost savings license meter. Opened and read Savings in Power Automate and Savings on agent flows in full; their permissions sections name table privileges, and neither page names a licence or meter.

claims.claim: A solution-based-flow prerequisite for desktop flow savings has not been documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" rules license prerequisites storage retention money saving setting. Opened Savings in Power Automate and Savings on agent flows; their solution-based prerequisites explicitly concern cloud flows and agent flows.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the roles for viewing and editing desktop flow savings rules.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" "privileges" "hour" "Flow Aggregation". Opened Savings in Power Automate and Savings on agent flows; their permissions sections concern cloud flows and agent flows, not desktop savings rules.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The storage location of desktop flow savings records has not been stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" "privileges" "hour" "Flow Aggregation". Opened Manage feature settings, Savings in Power Automate and the Organization reference; no passage locates desktop flow savings records.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly confirmed that Disable money-saving rules governs desktop flow savings.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" savings "time" "disable" admin switch default. Opened Manage feature settings, Savings in Power Automate and the Organization reference; settings documentation names cloud flows, agent flows and agents, without explicitly naming desktop savings.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that Flow Aggregation savings retention governs desktop flow savings.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" rules license prerequisites storage retention money saving setting. Opened Manage feature settings and the Organization reference; neither explicitly identifies desktop flow savings as using Flow Aggregation retention.

claims.claim: Learn does not state whether desktop flow savings appear on the automation center Savings page.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow" "savings" "automation center". Opened Explore Power Automate's automation center and Savings in Power Automate; the Savings page links to cloud flow savings and does not specify desktop savings support.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated how soon a desktop flow run appears in savings figures.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" "privileges" "hour" "Flow Aggregation". Opened Savings in Power Automate, Savings on agent flows and Explore Power Automate's automation center; no savings-update delay was specified for desktop flows.

claims.claim: A cloud flow run can take up to one hour to be reflected in its savings amount.
claims.quote: It can take up to one hour for a run to be accounted for in the savings amount of its cloud flow.

claims.claim: Only solution-based cloud flows can bear saving rules.
claims.quote: Only solution-based cloud flows can bear saving rules.

claims.claim: The documented cloud flow savings records are retained in Dataverse's Flow Aggregation entity.
claims.quote: Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity. Dataverse automatically deletes records that are older than the specified time frame.

claims.claim: Power Automate's automation center has a Savings page that tracks cost savings and time saved.
claims.quote: The Savings page, located in the Value section, helps you quantify the return on investment (ROI) from your automation efforts by tracking cost savings, time saved, and efficiency gains.

claims.claim: The documented environment money-saving control is under Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Environments. On the Environments page, select an environment. In the command bar, select Settings. Expand Product, and then select Features.

claims.claim: PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>) with {"ismoneysavingsallowed":false} disables permission to create money-saving rules.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/organizations; Primary key: organizationid; Operations supported: GETPATCH; ismoneysavingsallowed | Edm.Boolean | Indicates whether the maker can create Power Automate money based saving rules.

claims.claim: The documented savings-retention control is under Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Environments. On the Environments page, select an environment. In the command bar, select Settings. Expand Product, and then select Features.

claims.claim: PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>) with {"savingeventsttlinminutes":<minutes>} sets the default lifetime for new savings-event records.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/organizations; Operations supported: GETPATCH; savingeventsttlinminutes | Edm.Int32 | Default time to live in minutes for new Power Automate savings events records in flow aggregation.

claims.claim: The Dataverse PATCH requests can use Content-Type: application/json and If-Match: *.
claims.quote: Update operations use the HTTP PATCH verb. Pass a JSON object containing the properties you want to update to the URI that represents the record. ... Content-Type: application/json ... If-Match: *
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/update-delete-table-rows to sources and cite its Basic update section beside the explanation of the two API requests; it documents their Content-Type and If-Match headers. Keep the Organization reference for the endpoint and properties.

claims.claim: The Disable money-saving rules setting is Off by default.
claims.quote: Disable money-saving rules. | When On, prevents makers from creating money-saving rules and tracking money savings generated by their Power Automate automations (cloud flows) and by their Microsoft Copilot Studio automations (agent flows and agents). ... | Off

claims.claim: The money-saving switch is documented at environment scope for cloud flows, agent flows and agents.
claims.quote: When On, prevents makers from creating money-saving rules and tracking money savings generated by their Power Automate automations (cloud flows) and by their Microsoft Copilot Studio automations (agent flows and agents).

claims.claim: The default retention for savings events in Flow Aggregation is 365 days.
claims.quote: Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity | Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity. ... | 365 days

claims.claim: The retention setting controls savings records, not savings rules, in Flow Aggregation.
claims.quote: Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity.

claims.claim: The documented retention period determines how long savings records are kept.
claims.quote: Dataverse automatically deletes records that are older than the specified time frame.

claims.claim: Agents' savings are not stored in Flow Aggregation and are not affected by its retention setting.
claims.quote: Agents' savings aren't stored using the Flow Aggregation entity and aren't impacted by this setting.

claims.claim: For agents, makers can calculate time savings when cost savings are turned off.
claims.quote: Makers can still calculate time savings with cost savings turned off.

claims.where: Governance controls: money-saving switch paragraph; Open questions
claims.claim: A separate environment switch for time savings is not listed.
claims.quote: Searched: "time-saving" "rules" "disable" Power Automate settings. Opened Manage feature settings, Monitor time and cost savings for agents, and the Organization reference; no separate environment time-savings switch was found.

claims.claim: The API retention property uses minutes rather than the UI setting's days.
claims.quote: savingeventsttlinminutes | Edm.Int32 | Default time to live in minutes for new Power Automate savings events records in flow aggregation.

claims.claim: The API retention property specifies the default lifetime for new savings-event records.
claims.quote: Default time to live in minutes for new Power Automate savings events records in flow aggregation.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes calculation from flow run data and names no new connection, identity or permission.
claims.quote: You can define how long a task previously took when performed manually and let the platform compute time saved using flow run data.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a desktop savings tenant-wide default beyond the roadmap's statement that it is not enabled automatically.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" savings "time" "disable" admin switch default. Opened Manage feature settings, Savings in Power Automate and the Organization reference; no additional desktop-specific tenant default or enablement switch was found.
